title: Contact
subtitle: Minimal and calm communication. No marketing noise.

sections.heading: General
sections.body: If you have a question, a suggestion, or want to submit a work (MVP), contact us through the channel listed here.

sections.heading: Submissions (MVP)
sections.body: For now, submissions are reviewed manually. Include: work title, short description, media link, and preferred contact.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body: Please do not send promotional or price-related requests. PonyLife focuses on coordination and transparency.
